newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SLOVENIAN SHARES FIRM, SEEN TREADING WATER.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENIAN SHARES FIRM, SEEN TREADING WATER.

text.p: Slovenian SBI index firmed 0.79 percent on Friday, but traders forecast it would track sideways over the next two weeks due to expected low demand as most investors are still on holiday.
"I expect the index will stay between 1,520 and 1,600 points over the next 14 days," said Tomi Apollonio, an analyst of bank A Banka.

Traders said the index could grow significantly toward the end of August in expectation of fresh foreign investment in the autumn as the strong dollar is expected to draw new international investors to the market.
* The SBI index firmed 0.79 percent or 12.4 points to 1,576.89.

* Petrol trader Petrol was the most actively traded share, rising 2.71 percent to 25,030 tolars on volume of 5,848 shares and traders said it could rise up to 26,000 in the next two weeks in expectation of good half year results. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
